title: G5: Direct symmetric algorithm box must also assemble/factor A without any O(M)/O(N) object

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** required 'direct symmetric method' algorithm box.

A naive direct method forms $\mathcal A$ by multiplying $Z\otimes K$ ($N\times nr$), i.e. $O(N\,n^2r^2)$ — forbidden. The direct box must build the $nr\times nr$ matrix $\mathcal A$ from the observed-only representation (data block from the $q$ observed cells, each contributing rank-structured terms in $K_{:,i},K_{i',:}$ and $Z$-row products), in $O(q\,nr+n^2r^2+(nr)^3)$, then Cholesky/LDL$^\top$ solve. The attempt must prove the assembly avoids $O(M),O(N)$ and provide complexity, correctness, termination (Algorithm Rule).
